jobs.title: Security Guard Full Time Unarmed Patrol Observer
jobs.description:
Overview

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

As a Security Guard Full Time Unarmed Patrol Observer in Houston, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Government, and more. As an unarmed Patrol Officer at a government location, you will conduct routine patrols, maintain a visible presence to help deter security-related incidents, and support a welcoming environment for employees and visitors. You will provide exceptional customer service, communicate clearly, and respond to security-related concerns with professionalism. Join Allied Universal’s agile, reliable, innovative team, where a caring culture, teamwork, and integrity put people first.

Position Type: Full Time

 Pay Rate: $16.38 / Hour

Job Schedule

DayTimeMon10:00 AM - 06:00 PMTue12:00 PM - 08:00 PMWed10:00 AM - 06:00 PMThur10:00 AM - 06:00 PM

What You'll Do

  • Provide customer service to visitors, employees, and members of the public at a government location by carrying out security-related procedures, site-specific policies, and when appropriate, emergency response activities.
  • Respond to incidents, public concerns, and critical situations in a calm, professional, problem-solving manner, notifying appropriate site contacts and/or emergency services as directed.
  • Conduct regular and random unarmed patrols of government buildings, grounds, parking areas, and perimeter locations to help to deter unauthorized activity and report observed hazards or irregular conditions.
  • Monitor access points and visitor activity, verify authorization as required by site procedures, and maintain accurate activity, incident, and patrol documentation.
  • Support a professional and orderly environment by providing directions, assisting with public-facing inquiries, and following established protocols for government operations.

Minimum Requirements

  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us

  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial and Health Benefits: Enjoy access to a retirement savings plan, plus medical, dental, vision, basic life and AD&D, and disability insurance.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.

Closing

Allied Universal® is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. For more information: www.aus.com.

If you have difficulty using the online system and require an alternate method to apply or require an accommodation, please contact our local Human Resources department. To find an office near you, please visit: www.aus.com/offices.

jobs.title: $22.50HR/ RETAIL STORES UNARMED SECURITY OFFICER SEASONAL WORK STRTS SEPT
jobs.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a vigilant and dedicated Unarmed Security Officer to uphold safety and security across our premises. In this dynamic role, you will be the first line of defense, ensuring a secure environment through proactive surveillance, access control, and customer service. Your presence will help maintain order, prevent incidents, and foster a safe atmosphere for staff, visitors, and property. This paid position offers an exciting opportunity to apply your security expertise while contributing to a safe community.

Duties

  • Monitor surveillance systems such as CCTV to detect suspicious activity and ensure property security.
  • Conduct regular patrols of the premises, including buildings, parking lots, and restricted areas to identify potential security threats.
  • Control access points using access control systems, verifying identities and authorizations of employees, visitors, and contractors.
  • Respond promptly to emergency situations following established procedures, including fire alarms or medical emergencies.
  • Write detailed incident reports documenting any security breaches, accidents, or unusual occurrences for record-keeping and future reference.
  • Perform background checks on new personnel or visitors as part of security screening processes.
  • Assist with conflict de-escalation and conflict management to maintain a peaceful environment while adhering to security regulations.

Skills

  • Strong surveillance skills with experience operating CCTV and other monitoring equipment.
  • Knowledge of law enforcement procedures and emergency response protocols.
  • Ability to perform manual handling tasks safely, including heavy lifting when necessary.
  • Excellent customer service skills with a professional demeanor when interacting with the public.
  • Proficiency in incident report writing with attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Familiarity with security tools such as Taser devices (non-lethal), AEDs (Automated External Defibrillators), and fire extinguishers.
  • Understanding of physical security measures including patrolling techniques and access control systems.
  • Ability to perform first aid procedures including CPR and AED operation confidently.
  • Experience in performing background checks and ensuring compliance with security regulations.
  • Strong conflict de-escalation skills combined with effective communication for conflict management situations.

Join us as a Unarmed Security Officer and become an integral part of maintaining a safe, secure environment where safety is our top priority!

Embark on this seasonal journey where your expertise makes a real difference! We value energetic professionals committed to safety and community well-being. Join us in creating a secure environment that allows everyone to enjoy the festivities confidently.

Pay: Up to $45.00 per hour

Benefits:

  • Health insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Unarmed Security Officer
jobs.description:
Unarmed Security Officer – Residential Community

Pay: $17/hr

Location: Houston, TX 77019

Schedule: Full-Time, Split Schedule, 32 hours/week

  • Friday : 2:00PM – 10:00PM
  • Saturday: 2:00PM – 10:00PM
  • Sunday: 10:00PM – 6:00AM
  • Monday: 10:00PM – 6:00AM

City Security Services is seeking a professional, dependable, and alert Security Officer to provide security services within an upscale gated residential community. In this role, you will conduct vehicle and foot patrols, monitor resident and visitor activity, verify guest access, respond to security incidents, and maintain a visible security presence throughout the property. Successful candidates must be able to remain calm under pressure, exercise sound judgment, and handle emergency situations with professionalism and confidence.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct vehicle and foot patrols throughout a gated residential community
  • Monitor resident and visitor traffic entering the property
  • Verify guest access and assist visitors with directions as needed
  • Respond to resident complaints, disturbances, and suspicious activity
  • Contact law enforcement, fire, or EMS personnel when emergency situations arise
  • Conduct perimeter checks of community amenities, parking areas, and common spaces
  • Complete detailed Daily Activity Reports and Incident Reports
  • Provide exceptional customer service while maintaining a visible security presence

Requirements:

  • Active Level II Non-Commissioned Security License
  • Active Drivers License with a clean Driving Record
  • Reliable attendance and ability to work overnight shifts

Benefits of working for City Security Services:

  • Weekly direct deposit paychecks
  • Advanced Security Officer training
  • Career advancement opportunities
  • Ongoing field training provided
  • Recognition programs

Why Join City Security Services?

City Security Services is a growing security company committed to professionalism, accountability, and continuous development. We invest in our employees through training, mentorship, and advancement opportunities that help build long-term careers in the security industry.

Our culture is to Educate, Train, Certify and REPEAT

If you are looking for a stable position where you can make a difference while growing your professional skills, we encourage you to apply today.

City Security Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
About the position

Security Engineers is a respected provider of contract security services, operating across multiple States. With our headquarters in Alabama and strategically located Branch Offices throughout our operational footprint, our company is currently experiencing an unprecedented expansion, opening exciting prospects for both the organization and our valued employees. At the core of Security Engineers, we have a team of trained and professional Security Officers who serve as the backbone of our operations. We take great pride in setting a benchmark that others aspire to when it comes to our uniformed Officers. Not only do our Officers make a positive impact on the community, but they also build lasting relationships that endure over time. As Security Engineers continues to grow, we actively seek individuals who are interested in pursuing a rewarding career in the private security industry. We provide a wide range of work opportunities and are committed to accommodating your availability, whether you are seeking full-time or part-time positions. Security Engineers offers competitive wages and benefits. Security Engineers offers Paid Training at the State Minimum Wage.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct walking patrols to identify and report safety concerns
  • Monitor access points; verify IDs and credentials
  • Monitor surveillance systems for threats or suspicious activity
  • Respond to alarms, emergencies, and incidents per protocol
  • Maintain accurate logs of activities and incidents
  • Perform routine security tasks (e.g., locking/unlocking doors)
  • Assist visitors and employees professionally
  • Enforce site-specific Post Orders and security protocols
  • Ensure compliance with SEI and client policies (e.g., smoking, loitering, parking)

Requirements

  • Must have or obtain a Valid Security Officer/Guard License as required by the state licensing authority
  • Must be at least 18 years old
  • Level II TX License required
  • Ability to perform in fast-paced, high-pressure environments
  • Weekend availability
  • Strong situational awareness and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to remain calm and effective in critical situations
  • Basic computer skills; ability to use tablets for reporting
  • Stand/sit for at least 1 hour without break
  • Walk a minimum of ½ mile without stopping
  • Climb at least 20 commercial facility stairs without stopping
  • High School Diploma or equivalent
  • Able to obtain any & all security certifications/licenses

Nice-to-haves

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Office Suite
  • 1+ Year of Verifiable Security, Law Enforcement or Military experience
  • 2+ years of verifiable customer service experience

Benefits

  • 401K/403b Plan
  • Paid Training
